achievements.name: No Turning Back Now
achievements.description: Try to leave Silent Hill in the Observation Deck area at the start - turn around and follow the road to its end.

achievements.name: Enjoy Your Stay
achievements.description: Reach Silent Hill (story unlock when you obtain the South Vale map).

achievements.name: Nice and Cozy
achievements.description: Reach Wood Side Apartments (automatic on entering).

achievements.name: Let's NOT Party!
achievements.description: Shoot all 11 balloons spelling 'Welcome Home' in Apartment 207 of Wood Side Apartments.

achievements.name: Otherworldly
achievements.description: Enter the Otherworld for the first time (after interacting with the red door in Apartment 201).

achievements.name: Passed
achievements.description: Make your way out of Blue Creek Apartments after defeating Pyramid Head there.

achievements.name: Uncanny
achievements.description: Meet Maria at Rosewater Park.

achievements.name: All Seems in Order
achievements.description: Discover the secret of Room 106 at Jack's Inn - a Silent Hill 3 reference, found by inspecting the damaged wall during the South Vale revisit.

achievements.name: Leftovers
achievements.description: Find the pizza in Pete's Bowl-O-Rama - inspect the open pizza box on a table.

achievements.name: Admitted
achievements.description: Reach Brookhaven Hospital (automatic on entering).

achievements.name: Nightmare Fuel
achievements.description: Defeat the Flesh Lip boss in Brookhaven Hospital.

achievements.name: Alone Again
achievements.description: Survive the Pyramid Head chase sequence in Brookhaven Hospital.

achievements.name: Into the Abyss
achievements.description: Reach the end of the long staircase in the Silent Hill Historical Society.

achievements.name: Unforgivable
achievements.description: Defeat the Abstract Daddy boss in the Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Inner Sanctum
achievements.description: Find His room - enter Pyramid Head's octagonal chamber.

achievements.name: A Human Being
achievements.description: Kill Eddie in the final Labyrinth confrontation.

achievements.name: Scourge of Toluca Lake
achievements.description: Spend 10 minutes out on Toluca Lake - idle on the water after the Eddie boss fight.

achievements.name: Glimmer of Hope
achievements.description: Reach the Lakeview Hotel after rowing across Toluca Lake.

achievements.name: Truly Special
achievements.description: Reach Room 312 in the Lakeview Hotel.

achievements.name: It's Bread
achievements.description: Interact with the bread tray in the kitchen of the Lakeview Hotel's employee section.

achievements.name: Obsolete
achievements.description: Defeat the two Pyramid Heads in the Lakeview Hotel Otherworld.

achievements.name: That Part of Me
achievements.description: Defeat Her - the final boss.

achievements.name: Lumberjack
achievements.description: Find the chainsaw in a log stack near Silent Hill Ranch (New Game Plus only).

achievements.name: Merciless
achievements.description: Finish off 50 enemies with a stomp attack.

achievements.name: No Big Deal
achievements.description: Kill 75 enemies with ranged weapons.

achievements.name: Blunt Force Trauma
achievements.description: Kill 75 enemies with melee weapons.

achievements.name: You Never Know...
achievements.description: Try to open locked doors 50 times.

achievements.name: Shattered
achievements.description: Destroy 50 windows.

achievements.name: Making Peace
achievements.description: Reach the 'Leave' ending.

achievements.name: Vicious Circle
achievements.description: Reach the 'Maria' ending.

achievements.name: Only Way Out
achievements.description: Reach the 'In Water' ending.

achievements.name: Defy Even Death
achievements.description: Reach the 'Rebirth' ending (New Game Plus only - requires four special items).

achievements.name: The Goodest Boi
achievements.description: Reach the 'Dog' ending (New Game Plus only - requires the Dog Key).

achievements.name: Tinfoil Hat
achievements.description: Reach the 'UFO' ending (New Game Plus only - requires using the Blue Gem at four locations).

achievements.name: I Saw That Town
achievements.description: Complete New Game Plus on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Radio Silence
achievements.description: Complete the game without using the radio.

achievements.name: James of All Trades
achievements.description: Kill at least one enemy with the Wooden Plank, Steel Pipe, Handgun, Shotgun and Rifle in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Pieces Unarranged
achievements.description: Collect all Strange Photos in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Faster Than Fog
achievements.description: Finish the game in under 10 hours.

achievements.name: Archivist
achievements.description: Collect all memos in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: As Close as You Like
achievements.description: Finish the game without killing enemies using ranged weapons.

achievements.name: Party Like It's 2001
achievements.description: See all five classic endings - Leave, Maria, In Water, Rebirth and Dog.

achievements.name: Echoes
achievements.description: Witness every Glimpse of the Past in a single playthrough.
